stories.title: CSO-signed, versioned regional safety dictionary v1 with brand names
stories.story: As a doctor I want allergy, pregnancy and controlled-drug warnings to recognise the brand names my patients actually take so that 'Isotroin 20mg' or 'Mox 500' cannot slip past the safety checks.
stories.context: Today the lists live in code: RxSafetyChecks has 11 pregnancy-risk drugs and 6 controlled drugs per region, and AllergyDrugClasses has hand-written classes with a few brands (QA-16: 'Isotroin 20mg' for a 28-year-old woman gives no warning). stories.title: Patient receives a signed Rx PDF with a QR any pharmacy can verify offline
stories.story: As a patient I want a clear e-prescription with the doctor's registration number, signature and a QR code so that any chemist can trust it and refuse to reuse it.
